rationale: Audited repair after monolithic GET ended at 1568768 bytes and was rejected. Both machines served exact first/tail HTTP206 ranges with stable Last-Modified; one-MiB range hashes matched, taking 5.88s locally and 2.68s on worker3. Choose worker3 and the measured successful one-MiB range size, four bounded network workers, and at most three explicit transient-transfer attempts per range. Source/version/offset mismatches remain fatal. Preserve all failed partials; concatenate only complete independently hashed ranges in exact byte order, validate full size, then require archive/schema inspection. These are operational reliability parameters, not scientific or policy thresholds. No dummy dataset or fallback trace.
